cominciare.consejo: Regular verb of the first conjugation.

texto: The interviewer will ask: **Quando potrebbe cominciare?** (when could it start?).
To present yourself you answer: **Sono in grado di lavorare in squadra** (I am able to work as a team) or **Ho maturato esperienza nel settore**.

filas: I have five years of experience.
Sono in grado di gestire progetti.
I have a degree in economics.

frases.it: Buongiorno, si accomodi. Quando potrebbe cominciare a lavorare con noi?
frases.es: Buenos días, tome asiento. ¿Cuándo podría empezar a trabajar con nosotros?
frases.en: Good morning, have a seat. When could you start working with us?

frases.it: Buongiorno! Sarei disponibile già da lunedì prossimo.
frases.es: ¡Buenos días! Estaría disponible ya desde el próximo lunes.
frases.en: Good morning! I'd be available since next Monday.

frases.it: Ha esperienza nella gestione del personale?
frases.es: ¿Tiene experiencia en la gestión de personal?
frases.en: Do you have experience in personnel management?

frases.it: Sì, sono in grado di coordinare una squadra e sono molto motivato.
frases.es: Sí, soy capaz de coordinar un equipo y estoy muy motivado.
frases.en: Yeah, I'm capable of coordinating a team and I'm very motivated.

bloques.pregunta: How is «When could you start working?» cortedly formulated?

opciones.explicacion: Formal third person courtesy («potrebbe»).
Try you informally, unusually in a standard interview.
Imperfect that does not express a formal prospective request.

bloques.frase: Sono ___ di coordinare le attività del gruppo con piena autonomia.

opciones.explicacion: Fixed address: «essere in grado di + infinitivo».
Agrammatical construction; it would be called «ho la capacità di».
It is not the idiomatic locution of work competence.

bloques.pregunta: What does Roberto say about his career?
bloques.frase: Ho lavorato per molti anni come responsabile del settore vendite.

opciones.texto: For years, he served as head or head of the commercial department.
opciones.explicacion: Precise translation of «responsabile del settore».

opciones.texto: He applied for a non-paid intern in the shopping area.
opciones.explicacion: Distorts the previous experience of leadership and responsibility.

opciones.texto: He gave up coordinating employees for lack of formal training.
opciones.explicacion: It contrasts the work history credited to the response.

opciones.texto: Sarei disponibile già da lunedì prossimo.
opciones.explicacion: Manifestation immediate incorporation from next week on conditional.

opciones.texto: Non potrò lavorare prima del prossimo autunno.
opciones.explicacion: It postponed the entry several months without justification.

opciones.texto: Preferirei lavorare solo un giorno al mese.
opciones.explicacion: Strambotic demand outside the formal dialogue.

opciones.explicacion: University term in Italy for degree or degree.
It refers to the driver's license («patente di guida»).

opciones.explicacion: Official academic degree issued by the university.

opciones.texto: Temporary contract of internships in company.
opciones.explicacion: It combines the university degree with a contractual modality.

opciones.texto: Salario bruto anual especificado en nómina.
opciones.explicacion: It has no relation to financial remuneration.

intro: An Italian job interview uses the courtesy formula of you (**Lei**), and we talk about previous professional experience, university studies and practical skills.
